title: POC Cadet — staged onboarding, timeline, and responsibility matrix
content:
Context and objective:

This document captures the staged project plan for the Cadet POC (internal codename: "POC Cadet"). Purpose: validate Redwood Dedicated serving for Cadet Health's triage & summarization workflow under realistic load, demonstrate private deployment options, and produce a reproducible runbook and acceptance criteria so Cadet can decide on Dedicated vs Private.

High-level scope:
- Deploy a two-week POC covering: ingestion pipeline (HIPAA-safe sample), callflow-based summarization, a small interactive evaluation UI, and throughput/latency benchmarks for peak clinic hours.
- Validate cost/performance tradeoffs with 3 model variants (base fp16, quantized int8, and a memory-optimized variant).
- Prove replayable rollback and rollout policies via the Redwood Console (canary -> full).

Success criteria (must pass for POC sign-off):
1) Latency: 95th percentile token latency < 120ms for 4 concurrent clinician sessions (seq length median 600).
2) Throughput: sustained 200 requests/minute during a simulated 30-minute peak with <3% error rate.
3) Quality: automated eval suite (20 prompts) meets baseline ROUGE/paired-human pass on >= 85%.
4) Security & compliance: logs scrubbed of PHI in test runs, KMS integration validated in Private mode.
5) Operational: can perform a config rollback within 2 minutes with zero customer-visible errors.

Stakeholders and RACI (first-pass):
- Cadet Health (Customer Lead): Dr. Elena Ruiz — accountable for clinical validation and sign-off.
- Solutions Eng (owner): Aisha Patel — responsible for overall delivery, runbooks, and workshop facilitation.
- Platform Eng: Ben Thompson — responsible for Dedicated/private capacity provisioning and autoscaling policies.
- Applied ML: Maya Chen — model selection, quantization guidance, and eval harness.
- DevEx/SDK: Priya Nair — integration snippets, API keys, and sample app.
- SRE: Diego Alvarez — monitoring, tracing, and incident runbook.

Staged timeline (8 working weeks; milestones by sprint):
Week 0 (pre-engagement, 1 week):
- Deliverable: POC kickoff deck, privacy questionnaire, and sample data checklist.
- Actions: legal & security sign-off on data handling; Cadet provides anonymized sample dataset (<=500 docs).

Sprint 1 (w1–w2): Setup & baseline metrics
- Provision Dedicated test capacity (2x A100-equivalent instances) and Private control-plane sandbox if requested.
- Deploy baseline model (fp16) using default runtime profile.
- Run initial synthetic load (spike and steady) to capture baseline latency/throughput.
- Deliverable: baseline metrics sheet + known-issues log.

Sprint 2 (w3): Integration & feature parity
- Integrate ingestion pipeline and develop small eval UI for clinicians to label outputs.
- Hook up tracing and token-level cost dashboards in Redwood Console.
- Workshop: 2-hr interactive session with Cadet engineers and clinicians to align evaluation prompts.

Sprint 3 (w4): Optimization experiments
- Test batching, KV-cache reuse, and quantized variant (int8).
- Run end-to-end perf tests with 4 concurrent sessions (realistic prompt distributions).
- Deliverable: optimization recommendations and cost projection table.

Sprint 4 (w5): Reliability & rollout rehearsals
- Configure canary rollouts, fallback to smaller model variant, and automated alerting on quality/regression.
- Simulate failure modes (node loss, network partition) and validate graceful degradation.

Sprint 5 (w6): Customer validation week
- Cadet clinicians run acceptance tests in the eval UI; collect qualitative feedback and annotate regressions.
- Perform a final controlled peak simulation.

Sprint 6 (w7–w8): Sign-off & handover
- Produce final POC report, runbook, and recommended next-phase deployment (Dedicated commit sizing or Private onboarding checklist).
- Executive wrap-up meeting and sign-off.

Detailed task tracker (condensed):
- Pre-kickoff: Security questionnaire (owner: Aisha) — due W0-D3 — status: awaiting Cadet sample data.
- Provision infra (owner: Ben) — due W1-D2 — status: scheduled.
- Baseline perf run (owner: Diego) — W1-D4 — status: pending.
- Eval harness & prompts (owner: Maya + Cadet team) — W2-D3 — status: in progress.
- SDK snippets + quickstart app (owner: Priya) — W2-D5 — status: in progress.
- Quantization experiment (owner: Maya) — W3-D4 — status: planned.
- Canary policy config (owner: Ben) — W4-D2 — status: planned.
- Failure-mode rehearse (owner: Diego) — W4-D4 — status: planned.
- Clinician validation session (owner: Aisha) — W6-D1 — status: scheduled.
- Final report (owner: Aisha) — W8-D2 — status: draft.

Pre-reqs and runbook snippets:
- API keys and RBAC: Cadet to create service account with role 'poc-ingest' and provide public key.
- Data handling: all sample records must be de-identified; use redwood scrubber script (link in linked_artifacts).
- Monitoring: enable token-level telemetry; SLO alerts in Console with 5m aggregation.

Risk register (top 6 items):
1) Data readiness delay — mitigation: synthetic dataset + subset of real data for early runs.
2) Model quality regressions after quantization — mitigation: A/B compare and fallback to fp16.
3) Capacity underprovisioning for peak sim — mitigation: reserve 20% burst buffer and validate autoscale policy.
4) PHI leakage in logs — mitigation: strict scrubber, review by security, and temporary log redaction.
5) Network/VPC config issues for Private mode — mitigation: run connectivity test and provide detailed VPC diagram.
6) Unrealistic clinician prompts in evaluation — mitigation: workshop to co-design prompt set and reviewer rubric.

Workshop agenda (2-hr remote session):
- 5m intro & objectives (Aisha)
- 20m Cadet clinical workflow & edge cases (Cadet SME)
- 30m live demo of baseline model + eval UI (Maya & Priya)
- 25m collaborative prompt authoring (breakout or shared doc)
- 20m performance expectations & SLOs (Ben & Diego)
- 10m risks, next steps, and action items

Acceptance and handover deliverables list:
- Final perf and cost spreadsheet (CSV)
- Runbook: step-by-step deploy/rollback commands (Markdown)
- Workshop notes + prompt set (Google Doc)
- Eval harness code and reproducible scripts (GitHub repo)
- Executive one-pager with recommended next step (Dedicated sizing or Private onboarding)

Communication plan:
- Weekly status update (email + shared Slack thread) on Fridays.
- Urgent incidents: page SRE on on-call and notify Cadet primary.
- Demo & validation invites: calendar invites created by Aisha.

Notes / open questions for Cadet:
- Can Cadet provide a non-production HIPAA-compliant dataset with real prompt diversity by W0-D3?
- Preference for Dedicated vs Private for full rollout (budget constraints)?
- Are there specific docs or retention rules for audit logs beyond our default 90 days?

Next immediate actions (this week):
1) Circulate kickoff deck and Doodle poll for workshop times (owner: Aisha) — due in 48h.
2) Cadet to share sample data access method (S3 link or secure upload) — due W0-D3.
3) Platform team to confirm capacity reservation window and billing contact (owner: Ben) — due W0-D5.

Appendix: quick checklist for first provisioning run:
- [ ] Create service account and grant poc-ingest role.
- [ ] Confirm KMS integration test key available.
- [ ] Deploy baseline model container to dedicated pool.
- [ ] Run small synthetic load (50 req/min) and capture logs.
- [ ] Enable tracing and token telemetry in Console.

Document history:
- 2025-11-06: initial draft created by Aisha.
- 2026-01-15: added quantization experiment plan (Maya).
- 2026-02-28: updated success criteria and sign-off checklist (Ben).
- 2026-03-09: review pass with Cadet pre-sales; updated workshop agenda.
